LOFT rounded mobile UDP allocation accounting

mobile_patches.reason: Use the Android protected socket factory before QUIC connect while preserving existing TLS, seed, gate and wire cryptography.
Authenticate one ordinary session through the existing TLS/ALPN/seed path before TUN startup, using the existing dial gate and pool owner.
Own a standalone module for the selected unmodified Beast sender package instead of importing the upstream source tree.
Bound UDP queue slots and round buffer plus metadata byte admission before copying; preserve zero-length datagrams and release every queued owner once.
Use TCP default16KiB/max32KiB commitments and 64 pending forwarder admission; expose real gVisor worker Wait and safe failed-start cleanup.

Install existing Hydra before X logical streams and Pro ordinary sessions; record only fully accepted shaped DATA/PAD at actual producer completion, with full/partial framed-socket regressions. No wire version, authentication, encryption, timing delay or packet-only Pro shaping change.
Adopt upstream bounded stale pooled-session retry, TCP FIN tail preservation and HTTP/2 timeout, retaining the Android-local Hydra policy and observations.

owned_verification: tools/verify_owned_sources.py verifies owned_sha256 and complete file/patch coverage; source paths and source_sha256 are informational provenance and are never read by the clean-checkout verifier.
